critical_code_review_comments: Nit: I18nEmailPreviews.jsx uses `i18n-lang-tabs` container testid overlapping the prefix `i18n-lang-` — the query_selector_all('[data-testid^=i18n-lang-]') counts 6 instead of 5. Not a bug, but the container testid could be renamed (e.g. `i18n-lang-tabbar`) to avoid ambiguity in tests.
routes_email_previews.py duplicates the RTL wrapper logic per template — extractable helper is already present (rtl_wrap) which is good; keep as-is.
